title: spar-exocortex challenger report envelope
description: Output of Step 3 — Challenger dispatch. Schema-level anti-overlap: targetComplexity OR invariantChoice must differ from the baseline's value. The validator (orchestration) cross-checks against the baseline; duplicate values fail validation.

targetComplexity.description: Big-O complexity claim. At least one of targetComplexity or invariantChoice must differ from baseline (enforced by validator, not by this schema alone).

invariantChoice.description: What is precomputed vs computed online. At least one of targetComplexity or invariantChoice must differ from baseline.

targetLanguage.description: Must match baseline's targetLanguage (harness runs both candidates through the same adapter).

implementation.description: Self-contained executable text in targetLanguage. Must be runnable by the harness against shared tests + attacker's failingInput.

argumentWhyResists.description: Brief argument tying the new design to the attacker's input. In sequential mode this MUST explicitly address the attacker's named failure mode.

addressesAttack.description: True iff the challenger explicitly addressed the attacker's named failure mode. In sequential mode (default) must be true. In --parallel-attack mode may be false (challenger didn't see the attack).

operationalAssumptions.description: Optional. Operational assumptions the challenger's design relies on.
